label: AU-privacy-act-1988 Section 21Q

obligations.text:
21Q  Quality of credit eligibility information
(1)	A credit provider must take such steps (if any) as are reasonable in the circumstances to ensure that the credit eligibility information the provider collects is accurate, uptodate and complete.

(2)	A credit provider must take such steps (if any) as are reasonable in the circumstances to ensure that the credit eligibility information the provider uses or discloses is, having regard to the purpose of the use or disclosure, accurate, uptodate, complete and relevant.
